intent: Written help requests edit worried-about and modal/infinitive patterns, preserve private-after-lesson timing and specific desired help, and distinguish requests from confirmed appointments.
picturePurpose: Coded sentence contrasts expose actual written errors and two valid request structures; no new scene image is needed for grammatical comparison.

workshop.title: 把求助写清楚，也写通顺
workshop.instruction: 先改一句具体困扰，再比较两种礼貌请求的句式，最后检查所需帮助与成稿形式。不是照抄参考稿；自己的合理表达可以不同。

items.label: 把具体困扰写通顺
items.prompt: 哪句既把I am worry改通顺，又保留班级发言这个具体困扰？
items.reason: 具体困扰和worried about的写法已核对。再检查自己开头有没有让老师知道要谈什么。
items.hint: 这里比较形容词worried的示例。I worry about our class talk也可成立；不能把它误说成不允许的写法。
items.material: 写2—4句英文。你最近因为班级发言而担心，想向老师求助。说明具体困扰，并请求课后私下谈一谈。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。

composeBrief.title: 困扰句检查卡
composeBrief.hint: I am后可用worried；不要把动词原形worry直接放在am后面。
composeBrief.wrong: am后用形容词worried，不能写I am worry；I am worried本身可以成立，但这道题还要求说清班级发言的困扰。不能换成考试，也不能让老师猜具体事情。

fields.label: 哪句语法通顺且保留具体困扰？

choices.label: I am worry about our class talk.
I am worried about our class talk.
Speaking in front of the class.

items.label: 两种礼貌请求，各自搭配正确
items.prompt: 选一种开头，再接与它匹配的完整句子。
items.reason: 请求开头与后面的动词形式已匹配。两种都可礼貌请求课后私下交谈。
items.hint: Could I后直接接动词原形；Would it be possible后接to do。自己的正确请求句也可以不同。
items.material: 写2—4句英文。你最近因为班级发言而担心，想向老师求助。说明具体困扰，并请求课后私下谈一谈。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。

composeBrief.title: 请求句对照卡
composeBrief.hint: 不是只看哪个更长，要检查动词形式和私下、课后的信息。
composeBrief.wrong: Could I speak和Would it be possible to speak都可以；不能机械混搭成Could I to speak。

choices.label: Could I speak to you privately after the lesson?
Would it be possible to speak to you privately after the lesson?
Could I to speak to you privately after the lesson?

items.label: 帮助要具体，请求不写成已约好
items.prompt: 哪种结尾能让老师知道怎么帮你？
items.reason: 具体求助、请求状态和成稿形式已核对。再把自己的两到四句连起来，逐句检查。
items.hint: 练习开头、理清第一步等都可作为求助内容；不是保证立刻解决，也不能虚构老师已经答应。
items.material: 写2—4句英文。你最近因为班级发言而担心，想向老师求助。说明具体困扰，并请求课后私下谈一谈。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。

composeBrief.title: 结尾与成稿检查卡
composeBrief.hint: 说清希望得到的帮助，不替老师决定回应。
composeBrief.wrong: 要说明希望老师怎样帮助准备，如整理或练习开头；笼统问是否能帮点什么或提前问最终成绩不能替代具体准备需求。提出请求不等于已答应，原题还要2—4句书面表达。

fields.label: 哪句给出可回应的帮助请求？

choices.label: Could you help me with something?
Could you help me prepare the opening of my talk?
Could you tell me my final mark before I give the talk?

fields.label: 还没得到老师回应，怎样理解请求？

choices.label: The teacher has already agreed to meet.
I am asking; I still need the teacher’s reply.
Two to four complete English sentences.
A few isolated words instead of sentences.
Only say the answer without writing it.

transfer.stem: Which plan updates the facts and writes a clear, polite help request?
transfer.passage:
A different written request
You are finding it difficult to organise the introduction to a history project. Write two to four English sentences to the teacher. Explain the specific difficulty, politely ask to speak privately after the project session, and ask for help putting the opening ideas in order. You have not received a reply yet. Use fictional names if needed and no real contact details.

options.text: Explain difficulty giving a class talk, ask to talk privately after the lesson, and request help planning the first steps in two to four sentences.
Explain difficulty organising a history-project introduction, say that a private meeting after the project session has been confirmed, and leave out a request for help.
Explain difficulty organising a history-project introduction, ask to talk privately after the project session, and request help ordering the opening ideas in two to four sentences.
Explain the history-project difficulty, write “Could I to speak to you privately after the project session?”, and request help ordering the opening ideas in two to four sentences.

answer.display: Explain difficulty organising a history-project introduction, ask to talk privately after the project session, and request help ordering the opening ideas in two to four sentences.

explanation.strategy: 先更新困难、交流时间和求助内容，再检查完整句子与请求语气。

steps.text: 新困难是组织历史项目的开头，想在项目活动后私下交流。
steps.reason: 不能套回班级发言、课后的旧信息，也不能写成当众讨论。

steps.text: 请求帮助安排开头思路；尚未收到回应，不写成老师已经答应。
steps.reason: 用语法正确、意思完整的两到四句提出可回应的请求。

distractors.reason: 没有更新新项目、具体困难和交流时间。
没有收到答复，不能把请求写成会面已经确认；还遗漏整理开头思路的具体帮助。
情境和求助内容虽已更新，但Could I后要直接接动词原形speak，不能加to。

explanation.pitfall: 只改礼貌开头，却遗漏本次具体困难，或把请求写成已经约好。

visual.title: 具体困难 → 私下请求 → 所需帮助
visual.caption: 把信息写准确，再逐句检查搭配。

explanation.transfer: 用Would it be possible改写Could I speak时，动词前要补什么？
